bio: Roya Talibova is the Sultan Qaboos bin Said of Oman Assistant Professor of Public Policy at John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. Her research and teaching focus on political violence and its long-run effects on political economy and development, historical political economy, and quantitative methods. Talibova studies combat motivation in authoritarian regimes and the ways in which repression and ethnic identity interact with individual and group combat experiences.
